integrity_note: Proof is combinatorial and valid for all nonnegative zero gaps. Finite computational checks corroborate but do not constitute an infinite proof. Priority risk remains for unindexed work and the uninspected full text of a general 2008 subsequence paper.
scientific_limitations: The exact identity concerns binary linear source words with precisely three ones; the exact optimum is proved only among reversal-symmetric source words of odd length. No unrestricted optimum is asserted.
title: A closed palindromic-subsequence count for three-one binary words
